Guess the Number Game

Guess the secret number between 1 and 100 — with hot/cold hints, attempt tracking and three difficulty ranges.

📖 How to use

  1. Pick a difficulty and press New game.
  2. Enter your guess.
  3. Follow the higher/lower and hot/cold hints.
  4. Find the number in as few tries as you can!

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which difficulties are available?

Easy (1–50), Classic (1–100) or Hard (1–1000). Harder ranges give you more attempts.

What hints do I get?

After each guess you are told 'too high' or 'too low', plus a hot/warm/cold proximity hint.

Is my best score saved?

Your fewest-attempts record per difficulty is saved in this browser.

Does it work on mobile?

Yes — fully mobile friendly.
